title: Body Work — Weekly Classes in Innsbruck
intro: Body Work is a gentle, guided movement practice rooted in somatic and movement-based traditions. We explore the body with curiosity and care — through slow movement, breath, and natural contact with others. No experience needed. No right or wrong. Just show up.
price_info:
15–25 € per class (sliding scale)
Full season pass (17 classes): 220 €, 255 €
policy: Should a class need to be cancelled for any reason, the session will either be rescheduled at a time that works for everyone, or the amount will be deducted from your total.
contact_note: Full season registration is open now. Single attendance by contacting Tamara Maksymenko: +43 677 630 275 06
